sources.title: Trygve Helgaker, Molecular Integral Evaluation, 10th Sostrup Summer School lecture notes (2008)
sources.locator: Complete 41-page PDF; primitive Cartesian Gaussians and derivatives pp. 3–9; product rule and overlap/kinetic recurrences pp. 11–16; Laplace representation, Boys function, Hermite Coulomb integrals and one-/two-electron formulas pp. 18–27; screening pp. 22 and 35.
sources.source_kind_detail: Full lecture-note PDF from the University of Oslo course site, authored by Trygve Helgaker. The complete relevant derivations were inspected; numerical error guarantees and local integrability proofs are supplied by this batch rather than attributed to the notes.

read_evidence.extent: Full 41-page PDF retrieved. Inspected the complete relevant slide reasoning on pp. 3–9, 11–16, 18–27 and 35. Later Hartree–Fock, density-fitting, and periodic-system topics are not used.

contents.name: Primitive Cartesian Gaussian convention, spatial derivative and center derivative
contents.detail: Helgaker defines Cartesian Gaussian primitives and gives their coordinate derivative formulas on pp. 3–6. The local Definition additionally fixes complex contractions and integral conjugation conventions.

contents.name: Gaussian product theorem and finite Hermite expansion of an overlap distribution
contents.detail: The complete-square identity and polynomial/Hermite expansion appear on pp. 11–13. The local item proves the identity and finite-degree shift directly.

contents.name: Cartesian Gaussian moments and kinetic-energy shifts
contents.detail: The note differentiates Cartesian Gaussians and expresses the kinetic integrand as shifted Gaussians on pp. 6 and 16. The local proof supplies all coefficient algebra.

contents.name: Boys function integral, positivity, series, recurrence, and incomplete-gamma scaling
contents.detail: The integral definition and identities are displayed on pp. 19–21. The local item proves the termwise series, derivative and Gamma substitution under stated hypotheses.

contents.name: Hermite Coulomb derivatives and one-/two-electron integral formulas
contents.detail: The note derives the Laplace transform, Boys reduction, Hermite derivative representation, auxiliary recurrence and primitive formulas on pp. 18–27. The local proof adds explicit Tonelli/Fubini and dominated-convergence justifications.

contents.name: Coulomb Cauchy–Schwarz prescreening and its use in finite integral workloads
contents.detail: Helgaker states the positive-definite Coulomb matrix and screening inequality on p. 35. Positivity is proved locally from the Gaussian Laplace representation; the local statement accumulates all discarded weighted bounds.

contents.name: Fock/Kohn–Sham construction, self-consistency, density fitting, and Hartree–Fock postulates
contents.reason: The controlling design explicitly excludes a Hartree–Fock postulate. The local energy functional is a finite tensor contraction only and makes no self-consistency or physical-model claim.

sources.title: L. E. McMurchie and E. R. Davidson, One and Two Electron Integrals over Cartesian Gaussian Functions, UCRL-13791 (1976)
sources.locator: Complete 23-page UCRL-13791 report; §§II–IV and Table 1, PDF pp. 5–20, especially Gaussian product coefficients (2.7)–(2.22), Coulomb auxiliaries (3.9)–(4.17), and the finite integral loop organization.
sources.source_kind_detail: Full author technical report preserved by the UNT Libraries Government Documents Department. This is the 1976 report version, not a claim to have retrieved the paywalled 1978 Journal of Computational Physics publisher copy.

read_evidence.extent: Full 23-page report retrieved. Inspected the complete relevant reasoning in §§II–IV and Table 1, PDF pp. 5–20; unrelated reference and government disclaimer pages are not used.

recovery_attempts.outcome: The direct full-text request timed out after 15 seconds; search found the same authors' full UCRL-13791 report in the UNT Digital Library.
Alternative full author report fetched successfully; 23-page PDF was read in the relevant sections.

searches.query: "One and two electron integrals over cartesian Gaussian functions" McMurchie Davidson full text PDF
searches.outcome: Found the UNT Libraries record identifying the 23-page UCRL-13791 report and its PDF download; used the full report instead of an abstract or the paywalled 1978 article copy.
Confirmed the same author report in OSTI and the UNT digital archive; OSTI request timed out, UNT PDF succeeded.

contents.name: Gaussian product center and complete-square exponential prefactor
contents.detail: Equations (2.7)–(2.10) give the complete-square identity. The local proof writes out the vector algebra and the polynomial shifts.

contents.name: Hermite expansion coefficient recurrences for Cartesian pairs
contents.detail: Equations (2.17)–(2.22) give the finite Hermite expansion and coefficient recurrence. The local proof verifies uniqueness, support and both raising formulas.

contents.name: Nuclear-attraction and two-electron Coulomb reduction to Boys auxiliaries
contents.detail: Sections III–IV derive the base Coulomb integrals, Boys parameter, Hermite auxiliary functions and recurrence. Local proofs add absolute-convergence and differentiation-under-integral arguments.

contents.name: Finite contraction loops and reuse of auxiliary recurrence tables
contents.detail: Table 1 supplies the finite contraction-loop organization. The local algorithm declares deterministic index order, cache keys, work counts, certified statuses and energy bounds.

contents.name: The historical floating-point Boys branch thresholds as general certified error theorems
contents.reason: The report's numerical claims are tied to its 1970s floating-point implementation and do not provide interval inclusion or a general error theorem. Local Taylor, midpoint, incomplete-gamma and recurrence error bounds supply the required certificates.

sources.title: Jacques K. Desmarais, Development of Tools for the Study of Heavy-Element Containing Periodic Systems in the CRYSTAL Code and their Application, doctoral thesis (2020)
sources.locator: Full 297-page thesis; Chapter 3.3, printed pp. 26–31, discusses Cartesian Gaussian products, Hermite Gaussian expansions and alternative integral algorithms.
sources.source_kind_detail: Full University of Saskatchewan/University of Turin doctoral thesis. A search result for the Obara–Saika citation resolved to this thesis PDF, not to the 1986 paper; it is recorded as a distinct thesis, not misidentified as the paper.

read_evidence.extent: Full 297-page PDF retrieved. Inspected the title/permission pages and complete Chapter 3.3 material on pp. 24–31 relevant to Gaussian basis integrals. The chapter explicitly defers detailed method derivations to its cited sources; no theorem proof is imported from it.

recovery_attempts.outcome: Direct request for Obara and Saika's 1986 publisher PDF returned HTTP 403.
Search-linked full text was fetched and inspected; it is a 2020 doctoral thesis that cites the paper, not a copy of the paper. It was not treated as a substitute source for the original article.

searches.query: Obara Saika 1986 efficient recursive computation molecular integrals Cartesian Gaussian full text PDF
searches.outcome: Found publisher/CiNii metadata and an academic repository PDF link. Inspecting the linked PDF showed it was a related thesis, not the cited 1986 article.

The AIP full-text endpoint returned HTTP 403. No proof claim in this batch depends on the inaccessible article; the complete McMurchie–Davidson and Helgaker derivations are read and the local recurrence proofs are complete.

contents.name: Chapter 3.3 survey of Gaussian product functions, Hermite auxiliaries and recurrence-based integral methods
contents.reason: The thesis chapter explicitly omits most mathematical details and refers to the underlying papers. It served to identify the false search-result match only; all statements and proofs are supported by the full Helgaker notes, the full McMurchie–Davidson report, and local arguments.
